تنتحلون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَحِلُونَ (tantaḥilūna) /tan.ta.ħi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
# تُنْتَحَلُونَ (tuntaḥalūna) /tun.ta.ħa.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
